page.layout: One printed page (left page, p. 248) of running text, with Greek and Latin entries in one column; at the right edge a narrow strip of marginal notes (partly cut off by the binding and fold, mostly illegible); no running head other than the letter heading "KA" at top centre.

main_text.p: Καταηχλεῖω ω̃ subsequor. F.ἡσω.a. 1.καταηχλεῖ-θηκα. part.a.1 καταηχλεῖθεὶς αὐτὸν ω̃, Luc.23.55. P.καταηχλεῖθηκα.cum Dat.
Καταχήπτω concido. Fut. ψω. P.καταπεχήφα, Marc.5.5.

Καταχρημνίζω per praecipitia & praerupta loca dejicio, praecipitem deorsum ago, praecipito Luc.4.29. (ex κατὰ & χρημνίζω praecipitem ago, ἀ χρημνὸς ὁ praecipitium.) Fut. ἰσω. a.1. καταχρημνίσω. aor.1.infin. καταχρημνίσαι. prat.act. καταχρημνίκα. prat.pass. καταχρημνίσμαι.

Καταχρίνω judico, seu sententiam fero contra aliquem, contemno. Fut. καταχρινῶ. aor.1. κατεχρίνα ας ε ὠν. P. καταχρίκρικα. prat.pass. καταχρίκρίμαι cum τοῦ condemnatus sum. a.1. pass. κατεχρίθην ης η. aor.1.pass.subj. καταχρί-θῶ ης ἡ ὥμεν ἦτε. fut.1.pass. καταχρίθησομαι ἡ ἐτοιμ, Marc.16.16.
Καταχνεφίω (cum Genit. vi prapositionis κατ) dominor, semel fupero Act.19.16. Fut.δύσω. a.1. κατεχνεφίωσα. part. a.1. act. καταχνεφι-ξας αὐτὸς ὁ.

page.notes: Right-hand margin strip (cut off, damaged by the binding): fragments such as "Rom.1.30", "to.detraho", "Joh.8.3", "pass.", "deligo", "alleg", "relinqu", "lapid", "recc" and Greek catchwords are partly visible but too incomplete to transcribe reliably; they are not reproduced. Greek forms in the entries are read from a small, faded scan and may contain errors. The final line "Καταλ-" is a catchword at the foot.
